linuxIntegration.title: Linux & Omarchy Integration
linuxIntegration.description: Connect Voice Key to Hyprland for reliable push-to-talk and multilingual text injection on Wayland.
linuxIntegration.x11Ready: Linux X11 keyboard backend is ready
linuxIntegration.installedNeedsRepair: Integration is installed but needs an update
linuxIntegration.x11Fallback: Voice Key is using its existing Linux X11 keyboard backend. Hyprland integration is not needed in this session.
linuxIntegration.waylandUnsupported: This Wayland compositor does not expose the Hyprland integration used by Voice Key. Omarchy and Hyprland are supported first; use an X11 session for the legacy backend.
linuxIntegration.conflicts: Resolve these existing Hyprland shortcuts before installing: {{conflicts}}
linuxIntegration.backupHelp: Voice Key changes only its marked block and keeps a one-time backup next to this file. Removal preserves your other bindings.

settings.llmConnectionHelp: This LLM connection is shared by text refinement and translation.
settings.llmRefineEnabledHelp: Clean up, polish, and structure transcription text before it is injected.
settings.llmRefineManualHelp: Enter the Base URL, model, and API key to enable text refinement.
settings.translateOutputHelp: Only applies when refinement is enabled. When turned on, the refined output is translated into the target language with natural native phrasing.
settings.refineEndpointHelp: Only the Base URL is needed. Do not include /chat/completions; the app adds that path automatically.
settings.refineModelHelp: This mainly edits, polishes, and structures speech transcripts. Mini or lite tiers are typically faster and cheaper, and are recommended.
settings.durationWarning: Note: Each voice input is limited to 5 minutes and transcribed in 30-second chunks.
settings.durationWarningStreaming: Note: Each voice input is limited to 5 minutes and is recognized continuously while recording.
settings.lowVolumeModeHelp: Boost quiet speech in software before local recognition (may also amplify background noise).

microphone.label: Microphone
microphone.help: Choose which input device Voice Key records from.
microphone.unavailableHelp: The selected microphone is unavailable. Recording will fall back to the system default until it returns or you choose another device.
microphone.permissionHelp: Microphone permission is needed to show device names.
microphone.unsupported: This environment cannot detect microphone devices.

localAsr.title: Local speech recognition
localAsr.help: First use requires downloading a local model of about {{size}} for speech recognition. Audio is not uploaded.
localAsr.deleteConfirm: Delete the local speech recognition model? You'll need to download it again before using local recognition.
localAsr.deleteComplete: The local speech recognition model was deleted.
localAsr.unsupported: Local speech recognition is not available on this platform.

streamingAsr.title: Realtime speech recognition
streamingAsr.help: First use requires downloading a local model of about {{size}}. Speech stays on this device.
streamingAsr.downloadBeforeEnable: Download the local model before enabling realtime recognition.
streamingAsr.deleteConfirm: Delete the local model required for realtime speech recognition? Realtime recognition will be turned off, and the model must be downloaded again before reuse.
streamingAsr.deleteComplete: The realtime speech recognition model was deleted.
streamingAsr.unsupported: Realtime speech recognition is not available on this platform.
